title: Not Bad, Not Great, but a Good Value
text: Not Bad, Not Great, but a Good Value. Silicone toilet brushes are really the way to go. I'm not going back to dirty bristle brushes that take all day to dry, eww. There are probably some better shaped to clean an actual toilet bowl. The shape is difficult to use under the rim. However, they are sufficient enough that I will not replace them soon, but probably next spring or the one after. The holders are good, they have some weight to them so it doesn't fall over. The value isn't terrible, silicone toilet brushes are much cleaner, so I wouldn't strongly recommend them but I wouldn't discourage it either.
